questions.q: Which organisation completed 100 years of its existence on 1 October 2026?
options: Comptroller and Auditor General of India
questions.explain: The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) marked its centenary on 1 Oct 2026; India's first Public Service Commission was set up on 1 Oct 1926. Prime Minister (PM) Modi released a coin, stamp and book at Bharat Mandapam.

questions.q: In its October 2026 review, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)'s Monetary Policy Committee raised the repo rate to what level?
questions.explain: On 7 Oct 2026 the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) unanimously raised the repo rate by 25 bps from 5.25% to 5.50% — its first hike since February 2023 — and shifted stance to 'calibrated tightening'.

questions.q: Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)'s NVS-03 navigation satellite, launched on 30 October 2026, was carried by which launch vehicle?
questions.explain: NVS-03, the third second-generation NavIC satellite, was launched aboard Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle (GSLV)-F18 from Sriharikota on 30 Oct 2026.

questions.q: With the addition of Sukhna Wetland and Sauj Jheel in October 2026, India's total number of Ramsar sites rose to:
questions.explain: Sukhna Wetland (Chandigarh) and Sauj Jheel (Mainpuri, UP) took India's Ramsar tally to 103 in October 2026.

questions.q: Sukhna Wetland, one of India's two newest Ramsar sites, is located in:
questions.explain: Sukhna Wetland lies in Chandigarh, near the Outer Himalayas; the other new site, Sauj Jheel, is in Uttar Pradesh.

questions.q: The National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP), continued for 2026-27 to 2030-31, was renamed as:
questions.explain: The Cabinet approved NSAP's continuation with an outlay of Rs 53,428 crore and renamed it Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana.

questions.q: The GOBARdhan Central Sector Scheme to expand compressed biogas is run by which ministry?
options: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
questions.explain: GOBARdhan (outlay Rs 23,731 crore, Financial Year (FY) 2026-27 to 2035-36) is a Petroleum and Natural Gas Ministry scheme converting dung and agri-residue into Compressed Bio-Gas (CBG).

questions.q: India's Free Trade Agreement with which country came into force on 20 October 2026?
questions.explain: The India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement (FTA), signed in April 2026, entered into force on 20 October 2026, giving Indian goods duty-free access.

questions.q: Who became the 29th Chief of the Air Staff of the Indian Air Force on 31 October 2026?
questions.explain: Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit, earlier the Vice Chief, succeeded A. P. Singh as the 29th Chief of the Air Staff on 31 Oct 2026.

questions.q: How many medals did India win at the 20th Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan?
questions.explain: India finished 4th at Aichi-Nagoya with 85 medals — 21 gold, 27 silver and 37 bronze — its second-highest Asian Games tally.

questions.q: India's medal tally at the 5th Asian Para Games 2026, a new record, was:
questions.explain: India won a record 114 medals (30 gold, 35 silver, 49 bronze) at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Para Games, beating the previous best of 108.

questions.q: Who won the Nobel Peace Prize 2026?
questions.explain: South African jurist Navi Pillay, of Indian Tamil origin and a former United Nations (UN) High Commissioner for Human Rights, won the 2026 Peace Prize for promoting peace and international law.

questions.q: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded for work on:
options: Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats (CRISPR) gene editing
questions.explain: Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel won the Medicine Nobel for discoveries concerning light-gated ion channels and optogenetics.

questions.q: Francis Halzen won the Nobel Prize in Physics 2026 for his contributions to:
questions.explain: Halzen was honoured for decisive contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory at the South Pole and the discovery of high-energy astrophysical neutrinos.

questions.q: Who won the Nobel Prize in Literature 2026?
questions.explain: Canadian author Anne Carson won the Literature Prize for her bold and inventive oeuvre in dialogue with the classical tradition.

questions.q: The 2026 Prize in Economic Sciences was awarded to Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford for:
questions.explain: Hall and Woodford were honoured for developing macroeconomic models that help policymakers stabilise the economy.

questions.q: Each Nobel Prize awarded in 2026 carries prize money of:
questions.explain: Every 2026 Nobel Prize carries 12 million Swedish kronor, shared where there is more than one laureate.

questions.q: India's rank in the Global Hunger Index 2026 was:
questions.explain: India ranked 100th of 122 countries in Global Hunger Index (GHI) 2026 with a score of 24.1, in the 'serious' category.

questions.q: In the Global Innovation Index 2026 (World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO)), India held which rank?
questions.explain: India held 38th place of 139 economies in the Global Innovation Index (GII) 2026, remaining the top lower-middle-income economy; Switzerland was first.

questions.q: In the Henley Passport Index of October 2026, India ranked 84th with how many visa-free destinations?
questions.explain: India ranked 84th (with Algeria and Mauritania) with access to 55 destinations; Singapore topped the index with 193.

questions.q: India's gross Goods and Services Tax (GST) collection for September 2026 was approximately:
questions.explain: Gross Goods and Services Tax (GST) for September 2026 was Rs 2,03,521 crore, up 14.7% year-on-year — the third straight month above Rs 2 lakh crore.

questions.q: India's retail (Consumer Price Index (CPI)) inflation for September 2026, on the new 2024=100 base, was:
questions.explain: Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation was 5.54% in September 2026 before rising to 6.09% in October.

questions.q: Who took charge as MD & Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of HDFC Bank on 27 October 2026?
questions.explain: Anup Bagchi succeeded Sashidhar Jagdishan as MD & Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of HDFC Bank, India's largest private lender, on 27 Oct 2026.

questions.q: The International Monetary Fund (IMF)'s October 2026 World Economic Outlook projected global growth for 2026 at:
questions.explain: The International Monetary Fund (IMF)'s World Economic Outlook (WEO), titled 'Resilience Under Strain, Urgent Choices', projected 3.1% global growth in 2026 and 3.4% in 2027.

questions.q: Which state became the second in India to enact a Uniform Civil Code, in October 2026?
questions.explain: Gujarat enacted its Uniform Civil Code (UCC) after the President's assent in October 2026; Uttarakhand was the first state to do so.

questions.q: Armed Forces (Special Powers) Act (AFSPA) was extended for six months from 1 October 2026 in Manipur, Nagaland and which third state?
questions.explain: The Home Ministry extended Armed Forces (Special Powers) Act (AFSPA) in Manipur, Nagaland and Arunachal Pradesh for six months from 1 Oct 2026.

questions.q: The Defence Acquisition Council cleared procurement worth about how much on 26 October 2026?
questions.explain: The Defence Acquisition Council (DAC), chaired by the Defence Minister, cleared proposals worth about Rs 2.12 lakh crore on 26 Oct 2026.

questions.q: Indian Naval Ship (INS) Samarthak, commissioned at Karwar in October 2026, is the Indian Navy's first indigenous:
questions.explain: Indian Naval Ship (INS) Samarthak, built by L&T with over 75% indigenous content, is the Navy's first indigenous Multi-Purpose Vessel.

questions.q: Exercise VARUNA, in which Indian Naval Ship (INS) Trishul participated in October 2026, is a naval exercise between India and:
questions.explain: The 24th edition of the India-France naval exercise Varuna was held off Toulon, France, with Indian Naval Ship (INS) Trishul participating.

questions.q: India will export the indigenous Akash surface-to-air missile to which two countries?
questions.explain: India will export the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)-developed Akash missile system to Tajikistan and Turkmenistan, as reported in October 2026.

questions.q: India's women's hockey team won the Asian Games gold in 2026 after a gap of how many years?
questions.explain: India beat China 1-0 to win the women's hockey gold at Aichi-Nagoya, its first since 1982 — a 44-year wait.

questions.q: Lovlina Borgohain won the Asian Games 2026 boxing gold in which weight category?
questions.explain: Lovlina Borgohain won the women's 75 kg gold, becoming only the second Indian woman after Mary Kom to win Asian Games boxing gold.

questions.q: As per the October 2026 notification, Census 2027 population enumeration will be conducted during:
questions.explain: The MHA notified that Census 2027 enumeration will run from 25 Jan to 28 Feb 2027, with the reference moment at 00:00 hrs on 1 March 2027.

questions.q: Who became the first Indian to win the Oskar Klein Medal in October 2026?
questions.explain: Physicist Ashoke Sen became the first Indian recipient of the Oskar Klein Medal, awarded for theoretical physics.

questions.q: Justice Bimal N. Patel was sworn in in October 2026 as a judge of which international body?
options: International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea (ITLOS)
questions.explain: Bimal N. Patel took oath as an International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea (ITLOS) judge at Hamburg on 1 Oct 2026 for a nine-year term, succeeding Neeru Chadha.

questions.q: Dearness Allowance for central government employees was raised in October 2026 to:
questions.explain: DA for central employees and pensioners was raised from 60% to 63% in October 2026.

questions.q: Which scheme was among the three cleared by the Cabinet on 28 October 2026?
questions.explain: On 28 Oct the Cabinet cleared the Rs 10,000 crore Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme, the Khelo India Sports Goods Manufacturing Scheme and PM Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana.

questions.q: The Bankers' Books Evidence Act, 2026, which came into force on 1 October 2026, replaced a law of which year?
questions.explain: The new technology-neutral Act replaced the 135-year-old Bankers' Books Evidence Act of 1891.

questions.q: Which Vande Bharat Sleeper Express was flagged off on 31 October 2026?
questions.explain: The Varanasi-New Delhi Vande Bharat Sleeper Express was flagged off on 31 Oct 2026, among India's first Vande Bharat sleeper services.

questions.q: The birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi observed on 2 October 2026 was his:
questions.explain: Gandhi Jayanti 2026 marked the 157th birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi (born 2 October 1869); the day is also the International Day of Non-Violence.
